# platform-orchestrator_metadata_key (Resource)

An organization metadata key and its validation schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_metadata_key" "cost_center" {
  name        = "cost-center"
  description = "Internal cost-center identifier"
  schema_type = "string"
  pattern     = "^[A-Z0-9-]+$"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The metadata key name.
- `schema_type` (String) The metadata value type. Currently only `string` is supported.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A human-readable description.
- `format` (String) An optional string format constraint.
- `pattern` (String) An optional regular-expression constraint.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the metadata key was created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_metadata_key.cost_center cost-center
```
